strongest_angle: Investigating how the fraudulent Vanguard JV Cash Program raised $91 million from over 200 investors through unregistered securities, and examining the final SEC judgments issued against Conner and Welsh.

key_facts.fact: The Securities and Exchange Commission charged Dallas-Fort Worth residents Kenneth W. Alexander II, Robert D. Welsh, and Caedrynn E. Conner on April 29, 2025, for operating a Ponzi scheme that raised at least $91 million from more than 200 investors.
A federal judge in Texas ordered Caedrynn E. Conner to pay $8,575,250 in disgorgement over his part in the Ponzi scheme pitched as the Vanguard JV Cash Program.
The U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Texas entered final consent judgments on September 28, 2026, against Robert D. Welsh and Caedrynn E. Conner.

named_entities.name: U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Texas
